title: Finite-Volume Numerical Solver — Overview and definition
t: Finite-Volume Numerical Solver — Overview and definition
description: Discretizes conservation laws on general meshes for fluids, heat, and transport.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Discretizes conservation laws on general meshes for fluids, heat, and transport. A finite-volume solver discretizes mass, momentum, and energy conservation on structured and unstructured meshes with upwind, TVD, and higher-order schemes. Real implementations include OpenFOAM, SU2, and Fluent. It guarantees local conservation, handles shocks and multiphase flow, and scales on clusters.
capabilities: Incompressible and compressible flow with turbulence models
Conjugate heat transfer and multiphase (VOF) flow

title: Finite-Volume Numerical Solver — Actual implementation
description: Discretizes conservation laws on general meshes for fluids, heat, and transport.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. How Finite-Volume Numerical Solver is actually implemented. A finite-volume solver discretizes mass, momentum, and energy conservation on structured and unstructured meshes with upwind, TVD, and higher-order schemes. Real implementations combine Case-file dictionaries, CLI, Python wrappers (PyFoam) with MPI, a mesh library, linear solvers (PETSc). The implementation is verified by Verify on the 2D lid-driven cavity at Re=1000: centerline velocities within 2% of Ghia's benchmark and mass conservation to machine precision

title: Finite-Volume Numerical Solver — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Discretizes conservation laws on general meshes for fluids, heat, and transport.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Finite-Volume Numerical Solver, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Incompressible and compressible flow with turbulence models). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Incompressible and compressible flow with turbulence models and Conjugate heat transfer and multiphase (VOF) flow. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) solver) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
